result: Grace called it: a fish, nose on the left, tail on the right. Jack sketched it and took the top of the body. Hana noticed the start sat up at the tail and took the short run to the fork. Sam and Sofia had both claimed the lower tail, so Jack gave Sam the belly and kept Sofia on the tail. Grace then flagged a curl and a spur that weren't on the sketch, and they were pulled out. Leo questioned one stroke, and Jack admitted it was the bend at the nose, not the eye. Near the end, the start line broke at a sharp turn before the belly. Maya re-traced the start joint, Hana and Grace bridged the belly, Sam lifted a dark hook, and Priya was asked to stop taking down dominoes near the belly. Jack called hands off. When the start was pushed, 20 of 249 fell. Everyone said fish. The blind judges guessed a curved arc, a u-shape, or a smile.
